maria_cs: FYI  Horizon Finance just filed a new onboarding request: multi-stage pipeline (summarizer -> reranker -> sentiment). They need Private (VPC), HSM for key mgmt, PHI allowed, and strict latency SLAs. They're pushing for a kickoff next week and flagged this as high renewal risk. Any immediate concerns?

sanjay_se: Got it. Do we have sample payload examples and their QPS/latency targets? Which model families/sizes are they leaning toward?

maria_cs: From the intake: peak ~200 QPS, targets 99p: summarizer <300ms, reranker <600ms, end-to-end <900ms. Prefer open models: summarizer ~13B, reranker ~7B, a tiny classifier for sentiment. They'll share sample dataset after NDA.

linda_ml: We'll require PHI-safe tokenization, privacy checks, and our safety evals before any private deploy. Recommend Dedicated for predictable performance at 200 QPS. Request: 1-2k sample records + representative prompt/response pairs. If no finetuning required we can do evals ASAP.

owen_eng: Infrastructure note: HSM + VPC is supported but HSM availability depends on region. If they need HSM in a restricted region we may need on-prem or a partner region. For pilot, Dedicated in us-west with a fallback route to hosted variants is safest. Also need customer-managed certs and allowed IP ranges.

sanjay_se: I'll open the CS ticket and onboarding checklist. @linda_ml can you own safety + quality evals? @owen_eng please scope infra provisioning and lead staging setup. I'll handle customer enablement and tag renewal risk in CRM.

deploy-bot: Ticket created  CS-9876: Horizon Finance multi-stage onboarding (private + HSM + PHI).

maria_cs: They want a pilot in ~3 weeks and said renewal could hinge on pilot timing (Q2). If they return NDA + samples quickly, can we hit that?

linda_ml: 3 weeks is tight but feasible if: (1) dataset + prompt templates arrive in 48 hours, (2) no custom finetuning, (3) model artifacts are HF repos or standard checkpoints. Safety evals ETA ~4 days after data; perf bench ~5 days on Dedicated test pool. We'll prioritize this thread.

owen_eng: I'll provision a Dedicated test pool and staging VPC today. Need model artifact links (HF or .pt) and sample payloads. Customer upload instructions: `scp sample.jsonl cs_upload@redwood:/incoming/horizon/`

maria_cs: Sending checklist + NDA now. Asking for: sample 1-2k records, prompt templates, expected traffic shape, custom tokenization rules.

sanjay_se: Scheduling weekly sync with the customer. Added high renewal-risk tag in Salesforce. @vikram_sre please monitor network & storage quotas during perf runs.

vikram_sre: Added to CS-9876. I'll watch egress and GPU utilization during benchmarks and warn if we breach quotas.
